# DefinitionResourceRequest

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

What the host is asked for when a definition names a resource it does not carry.

Import from `@bonniepdf/core/definition`.

## Properties

- [`kind`](#kind): The kind of resource requested: `'image'`, `'font'`, `'svg'` or `'attachment'`.
- [`mediaType`](#mediatype): The media type the definition declares for the resource.
- [`name`](#name): The name in the definition's `resources`.
